rejected.title: Greek and Latin roots
card: Many English words are built from roots that come from Greek and Latin. A root carries a core meaning that is joined with other word parts.
Bio
a Greek root meaning life. It is in biology (the study of life) and biography (a written story of a life).
Port
a Latin root meaning carry. It is in transport (carry across) and export (carry out).
If you know a root, you can work out the likely meaning of a new word and spell it more easily. Use the rest of the sentence to check your guess.
rejected.remember: A root holds a core meaning. Knowing it helps you work out and spell new words.

a.q: A science word you have not seen before contains the root bio. What is the word most likely about?
opts: Living things and how they live
Carrying things from place to place
Having two parts or two sides
Writing letters and sending them
a.why: The Greek root bio means life, so the word is most likely about living things. Two parts is tempting because of words like bicycle, but that is not the meaning of bio.
a.clue: Recall what the card says this Greek root means.

b.q: Sam's family arrives at a hotel, and the staff call a porter. The root port means carry. What does a porter most likely do?
opts: Carries the guests' bags to their rooms
Cooks the guests' meals in the kitchen
Cleans the guests' rooms each morning
Takes the guests' payments at the desk
b.why: Porter contains the root port, which means carry, so a porter most likely carries bags. The other jobs are real hotel jobs, but none of them is about carrying.
b.clue: Which job matches the meaning of the root in porter?

a.q: The Greek root bio means life. Which word most likely names the study of living things?
opts: Biology
Biscuit
Bicycle
Bison
a.why: Biology contains bio, so it links to life. Bicycle begins with bi, which is not the root bio, so it does not fit the meaning of life.
a.clue: Look for the word that contains the root bio.

b.q: Dev reads that a factory will export toys. The Latin root port means carry. What does export most likely mean?
opts: Carry goods out to another place
Carry goods into a place from outside
Stop goods from being carried
Count the goods in a place
b.why: Export uses port, so it has to do with carrying. The part ex means out in this word, so goods are carried out. Carrying goods in is a tempting answer, but that does not match the way the word is built.
b.clue: Port means carry. Think about which way the goods are carried.

b.best: Carry goods out to another place

problems.detail: The clue ('Look for the word that contains the root bio') gives the answer away. Biology is the only option that contains 'bio', so a student can match letters without knowing what the root means.
The why explains the prefix 'ex' as meaning 'out'. Prefixes are taught in point 4, so this point should only mention it, not explain it.
